purpose: Research queue only. Never import this file from browser code or build unapproved city layers.

candidates.name: Kiel

crime_source.evidence: 2025 police PKS PDF, annex Table 10 (pp.31–32): 2016–2025 city-district cases; includes unknown-offense-location rows.

geometry_source.evidence: Official ArcGIS MapServer layer 38 returns 31 polygon parts, grouped into 30 districts. Exact names/Nummer joined and audited against police annex in CI. GovData WFS example returns zero features.

candidates.notes: LIVE: separate Kiel all-offense absolute CASE-COUNT overlay, NOT the nationwide violence/theft rate modes. 30 polygons audited; 2025 rate is unavailable because latest downloadable district population only reaches 2023.
limitations: No 2025 neighbourhood population in Kiel's public CSV: only counts, no per capita crime rate.
Police-only Hammer (20), Kroog (35) and unknown location (762) are not assigned to any polygon.
Kiel count-only cannot be used for national violence/property-rate comparisons.
Official detailed boundary differs slightly from national coarse AGS boundary; leave county source geometry unmodified.

candidates.name: Düsseldorf

crime_source.evidence: Police director Hammerschlag presentation dated 10 June 2026, PDF slide 2 'Gesamtkriminalität aller Stadtbezirke'. Full ten Bezirk 2022–2025 all-offense numeric table, downloadable via official OParl attachment 00589618.pdf, independently verified in CI.

geometry_source.publisher: Landeshauptstadt Düsseldorf, Amt für Statistik und Wahlen
geometry_source.evidence: 2025 official 10 Stadtbezirk GeoJSON fetched 2026-10-08. Original Stadtbezirk 04 contains a very small self-intersection; Shapely make_valid fixes it with 0.0m² change. Final union 217.407km², overlap zero, validated in Actions. GovData released Sep 2026.

candidates.notes: Released independent 10 Stadtbezirk annual count-only district dataset; 2025 police district sum 68,224 and city total 69,522, residual 1,298 remains unallocated.
limitations: Source includes all-offense totals, NOT district-level violent crime or all-property crime; category comparisons forbidden.
Absolute police registered cases, not per-capita risk or annual crime rates.
2025 ten district total 68,224 vs police citywide 69,522 (difference 1,298 not assigned).
Official BV6 PDF also contains district-6 street-level-category data, but do not infer those numbers for districts 1–10.

candidates.notes: 2025 public-space violence local CASE COUNT layer. Independent from national all-scene annual violence rates.

crime_source_2025_candidate.granularity: report citywide; municipality district annex requires verification
